defects.description: Text on task cards is extremely small and blurry, making titles and tags difficult to read
defects.location: All task cards in all three columns

defects.description: Task cards lack visible borders or shadows, appearing flat against the background
Vertical spacing between the two cards in each column appears slightly tight
defects.location: Within each of the three columns

top_fixes: Increase the font size of text inside task cards to ensure readability (at least 12-14px)
Add subtle borders or drop shadows to task cards to define them as distinct components
Increase vertical gap between stacked task cards to improve visual breathing room

manifest.prompt: Create a kanban board with three columns - To Do, In Progress, Done - each column containing two task cards with a short realistic title and a small colored tag.
